title: Time of one decision request under a thread cap
compared: The decision request of elephant-1 with 8 threads and 16 batch threads, with four and with two questions, against the confirmation run with 32 and 64 threads.
sample: 10 public jobs spread over the range of prompt sizes, one request each per setting; the 128 public jobs of the confirmation run; 6 requests sent in bursts. All on a 2x EPYC 9354 server.

verdict: With two questions no single request went over the 300 s limit, with four questions 1 did. Sent at once, 3 of 6 requests went over it.
note: The 90th percentile is left out where ten requests were timed. The comments on the pull request give 111 and 57 seconds for the first two rows; they took the upper of the two middle values.
